title: 第十四章 天极仙府
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
谢清猗紧紧盯着那枚玉简，面颊通红，还好，对方没接到，他现在是自己老板诶，觉得除了能问对方炼丹，好像没有什么好话题，要不然等他联系自己……

    昏暗的天光透不进大殿，一道身影与无边的黑暗溶于一片般，玄色的袖摆秀着暗金秀文，流光忽明忽暗的在其上有走着，趁着那指节分明的修长大手愈发冷白，那双幽深的黑眸盯着掌心中忽然一亮的玉简，却瞬息又暗了下去，他眉梢微挑，眸光更深了些。

    这些时日，不是在房中打坐修炼，吸纳舟身聚灵阵汇聚的精纯灵气，便是在甲板开阔处迎着罡风演练剑招，衣袂翩飞，冰灵根的剑意带着刺骨霜寒，弟子纷纷避开而行。

    这是她自从穿书后最舒服的日子，比穿书前都要爽～除了没手机，偶尔嘴馋。

    还有让谢清猗的疑惑越来越深，不是梦到那个看不清的男人，就是她又被刀捅穿，她必须等到了仙府要去想办法解决这个问题，这简直太让她崩溃了……

    只能在第二天做别的事转移注意力，不再去想梦境里的残影低语或是心脏如同被刨开般痛。出来透气时，见师尊与安姑姑在飞舟上法亭中对弈。

    亭子以通透的琉璃与灵木搭建，檐角悬着驱邪静心的玉铃。一个执黑子清冷如霜，一个捏白子笑靥如花，棋子落于寒玉枰上的清脆声响，伴着偶尔的只言片语，随风传来断续的字句，竟是说不出的琴瑟和鸣。

    谢清猗倚在朱栏边，望着琉璃亭中对弈的两人出神。心中一动，原来两情相悦竟是这般光景，像冬日里第一缕穿透薄雾的天光倾泄而下，瞬间将她被梦境所困的阴霾全部吹散。

    “穿书大神在上。”她对着流云深处合十双手，眼波流转间带着几分虔诚与俏皮，“信女别无奢求，只愿得遇一位清风明月般的仙君，和我谈个甜甜的恋爱！”檐角风铃忽地叮咚作响，似在回应。

    脑海中不由得想起那个人，昳丽俊美的面容，他身上清冽的冷香，让她心跳加速，面颊绯红，睫毛微垂，怎么才发现自己这么花痴……好吧，她承认了。

    她忍不住扑哧一笑着补充，“切记切记—定要惊才绝艳，貌若谪仙！”

    谢清猗看着路过的弟子，发觉除却第一日引路的贺师侄外，还有五位内门弟子，皆身着不同形制的弟子服，气息精纯，显然根基扎实。

    听说他们此次都是在外历练时恰逢妖魔肆虐，毁去修仙界多处传送法阵。幸而遇上师尊顺路搭载，若单靠他们御剑返回宗门，怕是早已灵力枯竭，从云端跌落。

    “谢师叔。”贺俊宇眼睛亮晶晶地凑近，手里还拿着一卷未读完的玉简，“师叔祖平日都指点您参悟哪些功法？”

    “谢师叔，能否让弟子瞻仰一下您的本命灵剑？听说亲传弟子的灵剑都是宝物！”

    “听说师叔祖至今只收了您一位亲传，这可是真的？”

    谢清猗轻呷一口已微凉的灵茶，揉了揉发胀的太阳穴：“小贺，你且去寻他们玩耍，我该练剑了。”

    她刚要起身开溜，就听见身后传来委屈的嗓音。谢清猗身形微僵，缓缓转过身来，扯出个勉强的笑。

    “师叔定是嫌我烦了……”少年耷拉着脑袋，眼巴巴地望着她，活像只被抛弃的小兽。

    “哪有的事。”她干笑两声，暗自叫苦。

    谁知贺俊宇又从剑诀精要说到各峰趣闻，某位长老的丹药被最喜爱的灵兽偷吃，乃至哪个峰的师姐主动去追求掌门首徒大弟子。

    此时云海染上橘红与绛紫，谢清猗已是口干舌燥，头脑发昏。

    “谢师叔下午怎不来寻我？”一道清脆女声自廊柱后响起。

    身着淡蓝流云纹弟子服，模样水灵的少女翩然而至，发间别着一枚小巧的玉簪。她先是嫌弃地睨了贺俊宇一眼，唇角扬起狡黠的弧度得意道：“原是被这天字第一号烦人精绊住了脚。”

    “江芮儿！整个天极仙府就数你最讨人嫌！”少年如同被踩了尾巴，立刻愤愤回怼。

    这两人也不知是前世结了什么梁子，一见面便如斗鸡般剑拔弩张，周身灵气都隐隐躁动。
content_en:
Xie Qingyi stared at the jade slip closely, her cheeks flushed. Fortunately, the other party didn't pick it up. He was his boss now. He felt that besides asking the other party about making alchemy, there seemed to be no good topics to talk about. Otherwise, he would have to wait until he contacted her...

    The dim skylight could not penetrate into the hall, and a figure melted into the boundless darkness. The black sleeves showed off the dark gold text, and the light flickered on it. While the slender hands with clearly defined knuckles became colder and whiter, the deep black eyes stared at the jade slip in the palm that suddenly lit up, but then dimmed again in an instant. His eyebrows were raised slightly, and his eyes became darker.

    During these days, they were either meditating and practicing in the room, absorbing the pure spiritual energy gathered by the spirit gathering array on the boat body, or practicing sword moves in the open area of ​​the deck facing the strong wind. Their clothes were flying, and the sword intent of the ice spirit root was filled with biting frost, and the disciples avoided it one after another.

    This is the most comfortable day since she wore a book, and it feels better than before wearing a book ~ except for not having a mobile phone and occasionally being greedy.

    Xie Qingyi's doubts were getting deeper and deeper. Either she dreamed of the man she couldn't see clearly, or she was stabbed through by a knife again. She had to wait until she got to Xianfu to find a way to solve this problem. This simply made her collapse...

    I can only do other things to divert my attention the next day, and no longer think about the afterimage whispering in the dream or the pain in my heart that feels like it is being ripped open. When I came out for some fresh air, I saw Master and Aunt An playing chess in the flying boat's pavilion.

    The pavilion is made of transparent glass and spiritual wood, and jade bells used to ward off evil spirits and meditate are hung at the corners of the eaves. One holding the black piece is as cold as frost, the other holding the white piece has a smile as bright as a flower. The clear sound of the chess piece falling on the cold jade scale, accompanied by occasional fragments of words, intermittent words carried by the wind, is actually the unspeakable harmony of the piano and the harp.

    Xie Qingyi leaned against the red railing, watching the two people playing chess in the Liuli Pavilion in trance. Her heart moved, and it turned out that the two people were in love like this. It was like the first ray of skylight penetrating through the mist in winter, instantly blowing away all the haze trapped in her dream.

    "The great god who wears books is here." She clasped her hands towards the depths of the flowing clouds, her eyes moving with a bit of piety and playfulness, "A faithful woman has nothing to ask for, I only hope to meet an immortal king who is as clear as the breeze and the bright moon, and have a sweet love with me!" The wind chime on the corner of the eaves suddenly tinkled, as if in response.

    She couldn't help but think of that person in her mind, his beautiful and handsome face, and the refreshing cold fragrance on his body, which made her heart beat faster, her cheeks turned red, and her eyelashes drooped slightly. How did she realize that she was so infatuated... Okay, she admitted it.

    She couldn't help but smile and added, "Remember, remember - you must be stunningly talented and beautiful, and look like an immortal!"

    Xie Qingyi looked at the passing disciples and realized that in addition to Master Nephew He who led the way on the first day, there were five inner disciples. They were all wearing different forms of disciple uniforms. Their auras were pure, and they obviously had a solid foundation.

    I heard that while they were out training this time, demons were raging and destroyed many teleportation circles in the world of immortality. Fortunately, the master offered him a lift. If they had relied solely on them to control the sword and return to the sect, they would have exhausted their spiritual power and fallen from the clouds.

    "Thank you, Uncle Master." He Junyu came closer with bright eyes, holding an unfinished jade slip in his hand, "What skills does Master Master teach you to learn on a daily basis?"

    "Uncle Xie, can you let your disciples admire your natal spiritual sword? I heard that the spiritual swords of your direct disciples are all treasures!"

    "I heard that my uncle has only accepted one of your direct descendants so far. Is this true?"

    Xie Qingyi took a sip of the slightly cool spiritual tea and rubbed his swollen temples: "Xiao He, go and play with them. It's time for me to practice my sword."

    Just as she was about to get up and run away, she heard an aggrieved voice coming from behind her. Xie Qingyi stiffened slightly, turned around slowly, and gave a forced smile.

    "Uncle Master must be annoyed with me..." The young man lowered his head and looked at her longingly, like an abandoned little beast.

    "It's nothing." She laughed dryly, complaining secretly.

    Who would have thought that He Junyu would tell anecdotes about various peaks from the essence of sword tactics, such as a certain elder's elixir being stolen by his favorite spirit beast, and even a senior sister from a certain peak taking the initiative to pursue the chief disciple.

    At this time, the sea of ​​clouds was dyed orange and purple, and Xie Qingyi's mouth was dry and his mind was dizzy.

    "Uncle Xie, why don't you come to see me this afternoon?" A clear female voice sounded from behind the pillars.

    Wearing a light blue flowing cloud-patterned disciple's uniform, a young girl with a graceful appearance came gracefully, with a small jade hairpin in her hair. She first glanced at He Junyu with disgust, then raised the corners of her lips with a sly arc and said proudly: "It turned out that I was tripped up by this most annoying person in the world."

    "Jiang Ruier! You are the most annoying person in the entire Tianji Immortal Palace!" The young man immediately responded angrily as if his tail had been stepped on.

    The two of them didn't know what kind of feud they had in their previous lives. When they met, they were as tense as fighting cocks, and the aura around them was faintly restless.
